[[Supersport United]] were the defending champions, having won their second premier league title in the [[2008–09 South African Premiership|2008–09 season]]. The campaign began in August 2009, and ended in March 2010. A total of 16 teams competed in the league. [[SuperSport United]] were crowned champions for the third successive time two matches before the end despite losing to [[Bidvest Wits]] (1–2) in the last match.{{cite news|url=https://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/clubfootball/news/newsid=1173708.html |title=SuperSport lose but claim title |date=2010-02-24 |work=FIFA.com |publisher=[[FIFA]] |agency=[[Agence France-Presse]] |access-date=2010-05-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100504001559/http://www.fifa.com/worldfootball/clubfootball/news/newsid%3D1173708.html |archive-date=4 May 2010 |url-status=dead }} ==Clubs== *[[Ajax Cape Town]] *[[AmaZulu F.C.
